quote: Sixty healthy C. auratus gibelio , with average length 10 ± 1 cm, were kept at 25 ± 1°C with an acclimation period of 14 days.
statement: 六十条健康的鲤鲫（C. auratus gibelio）在25±1°C的条件下饲养，并进行了为期14天的适应期。
text_zh: 六十条健康的鲤鲫（C. auratus gibelio）在25±1°C的条件下饲养，并进行了为期14天的适应期。
text_en: Sixty healthy Prussian carp (C. auratus gibelio) were reared at 25±1°C and underwent a 14-day acclimation period.

quote: Setelah diberikan perlakuan (15 menit) ikan dipindahkan kembali ke air tawar yang bersih dan tidak lama kemudian ikan kembali aktif berenang.
statement: Ikan kembali aktif berenang setelah dipindahkan ke air tawar bersih pasca-perendaman selama 15 menit.
text_en: Ikan kembali aktif berenang setelah dipindahkan ke air tawar bersih pasca-perendaman selama 15 menit.

quote: perlakuan A, B, dan C tidak berbeda nyata, hal ini menunjukkan bahwa pemberian perasan buah mengkudu pada konsentrasi 0%, 2,5%, dan 3% tidak efektif untuk mengendalikan (melepas) Argulus dengan waktu perendaman 15 menit
statement: Konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu 0%, 2,5%, dan 3% dengan waktu perendaman 15 menit tidak efektif melepas parasit Argulus.
text_en: Konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu 0%, 2,5%, dan 3% dengan waktu perendaman 15 menit tidak efektif melepas parasit Argulus.

quote: Pada perlakuan D dan perlakuan E menunjukkan hasil yang sama dan menunjukkan hasil yang berbeda nyata dengan perlakuan A, hal ini disebabkan oleh besarnya konsentrasi yang digunakan pada perlakuan D (3,5%) dan perlakuan E (4%) cukup optimal untuk membuat kandungan Alkaloid dan Xeronine pada buah mengkudu bereaksi dengan waktu perendaman 15 menit.
statement: Konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu 3,5% dan 4% dengan waktu perendaman 15 menit cukup optimal untuk reaksi zat antiparasit.
text_en: Konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu 3,5% dan 4% dengan waktu perendaman 15 menit cukup optimal untuk reaksi zat antiparasit.

quote: No parasites were found in the diseased fish after examination using inverted microscope.
statement: 使用倒置显微镜检查病鱼后未发现寄生虫。
text_zh: 使用倒置显微镜检查病鱼后未发现寄生虫。
text_en: No parasites were found after examining sick fish using an inverted microscope.

quote: No cytopathic effect was observed in the cells, thus excluding viral infection.
statement: 细胞中未观察到细胞病变效应，从而排除了病毒感染。
text_zh: 细胞中未观察到细胞病变效应，从而排除了病毒感染。
text_en: No cytopathic effect was observed in the cells, thereby ruling out viral infection.

quote: Penelitian ini dilakukan infestasi buatan pada ikan mas komet (Carassius auratus auratus) sebanyak 3 ekor Argulus per 1 ekor ikan, hal ini dilakukan berdasarkan pendapat Yildiz dan Kumantas (2002) yang mengatakan infestasi 3 ekor Argulus pada ikan juvenile termasuk dalam kategori berat.
statement: Infestasi buatan dengan 3 ekor Argulus per ikan dianggap sebagai kategori berat berdasarkan literatur sebelumnya.
text_en: Infestasi buatan dengan 3 ekor Argulus per ikan dianggap sebagai kategori berat berdasarkan literatur sebelumnya.

quote: Berdasarkan hasil uji ANAVA menunjukkan bahwa perendaman perasan buah mengkudu berpengaruh terhadap infestasi Argulus pada ikan mas komet.
statement: Perendaman perasan buah mengkudu memiliki pengaruh terhadap tingkat infestasi Argulus pada ikan mas komet.
text_en: Perendaman perasan buah mengkudu memiliki pengaruh terhadap tingkat infestasi Argulus pada ikan mas komet.

quote: Pada perlakuan D dan perlakuan E tidak terdapat perbedaan nyata, tetapi berdasarkan tingkat kematian ikan terdapat perbedaan
statement: Meskipun efektivitas pelepasan parasit pada perlakuan D dan E serupa, terdapat perbedaan dalam tingkat kematian ikan di antara kedua perlakuan tersebut.
text_en: Meskipun efektivitas pelepasan parasit pada perlakuan D dan E serupa, terdapat perbedaan dalam tingkat kematian ikan di antara kedua perlakuan tersebut.
counterevidence: Tingkat kematian ikan berbeda meskipun efektivitas pengendalian parasit sama.

quote: Penelitian ini bersifat eksperimenta yang terdiri dari lima perlakuan dan empat ulangan dengan konsentrasi berbeda pada masing-masing perlakuan, yaitu (A) tanpa menggunakan perasan buah mengkudu (kontrol), (B) perasan buah mengkudu dengan konsentrasi 2,5 %, (C) perasan buah mengkudu dengan konsentrasi 3 %, (D) perasan buah mengkudu dengan konsentrasi 3,5 %, dan (E) perasan buah mengkudu dengan konsentrasi 4 %.
statement: Penelitian ini menguji efek perasan buah mengkudu pada ikan mas komet dengan lima perlakuan konsentrasi berbeda (0%, 2.5%, 3%, 3.5%, dan 4%) serta kontrol.
text_en: Penelitian ini menguji efek perasan buah mengkudu pada ikan mas komet dengan lima perlakuan konsentrasi berbeda (0%, 2.5%, 3%, 3.5%, dan 4%) serta kontrol.

quote: Penentuan konsentrasi yang digunakan berdasarkan dari penelitian pendahuluan, dimana ikan akan dapat bertahan hidup pada perasan buah mengkudu dibawah konsentrasi 4,5 %.
statement: Konsentrasi uji ditentukan berdasarkan penelitian pendahuluan yang menunjukkan bahwa ikan mas komet dapat bertahan hidup pada konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu di bawah 4,5%.
text_en: Konsentrasi uji ditentukan berdasarkan penelitian pendahuluan yang menunjukkan bahwa ikan mas komet dapat bertahan hidup pada konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu di bawah 4,5%.

quote: Ikan mas komet yang digunakan rata-rata berukuran 5-7 cm (juvenile), awalnya ikan diaklimatisasi terlebih dahulu ke akuarium selama 24 jam, kemudian ikan tersebut diinfestasi dengan Argulus.
statement: Ikan mas komet juvenil diaklimatisasi selama 24 jam sebelum diinfestasi dengan parasit Argulus.
text_en: Ikan mas komet juvenil diaklimatisasi selama 24 jam sebelum diinfestasi dengan parasit Argulus.

quote: Adapun cara untuk melakukan infestasi buatan tersebut adalah ikan mas komet (20 ekor) satu persatu dimasukkan dalam gelas kaca kemudian menyusul Argulus (3 ekor/gelas) dimasukkan dan ditunggu selama 15 menit, apabila Argulus sudah menempel pada ikan mas komet (telah terinfestasi Argulus) dimasukkan dalam akuarium yang telah terisi air (Kismiyati, 2009).
statement: Infestasi buatan dilakukan dengan memasukkan ikan mas komet dan Argulus ke dalam gelas kaca selama 15 menit hingga parasit menempel, kemudian ikan dipindahkan ke akuarium.
text_en: Infestasi buatan dilakukan dengan memasukkan ikan mas komet dan Argulus ke dalam gelas kaca selama 15 menit hingga parasit menempel, kemudian ikan dipindahkan ke akuarium.

quote: Recently, diseases with characteristic symptoms of hemorrhaging have occurred in cultured C. auratus gibelio in a fish farm in Tianjin, China.
statement: 天津一家养殖场养殖的银鲫近期发生了具有出血特征的疾病。
text_zh: 天津一家养殖场养殖的银鲫近期发生了具有出血特征的疾病。
text_en: A farm in Tianjin recently experienced a disease with hemorrhagic characteristics among its farmed silver crucian carp.

quote: To elaborate, clinical observation on the diseased fish showed abdominal distension and congestion at each fin base (Figure 1A).
statement: 对病鱼的临床观察显示腹部膨胀且各鳍基部充血。
text_zh: 对病鱼的临床观察显示腹部膨胀且各鳍基部充血。
text_en: Clinical observation of diseased fish showed abdominal distension and congestion at the base of each fin.

quote: The abdominal cavities and intestines of the morbid fish were filled with a substantial amount of ascitic fluid (Figure 1B), and the fish gills were pink or gray due to ischemia (Figure 1C).
statement: 病鱼腹腔和肠道充满大量腹水，鱼鳃因缺血呈粉红色或灰色。
text_zh: 病鱼腹腔和肠道充满大量腹水，鱼鳃因缺血呈粉红色或灰色。
text_en: The abdominal cavity and intestines of diseased fish are filled with a large amount of ascites, and the gills appear pink or gray due to ischemia.

quote: mas komet atau mempersingkat waktu hidup dari ikan itu sendiri, hal tersebut dikarenakan kadar alkaloid yang tinggi diperairan, bersifat racun pada ikan.
statement: Kadar alkaloid yang tinggi di perairan bersifat racun bagi ikan mas komet dan dapat mempersingkat waktu hidupnya.
text_en: Kadar alkaloid yang tinggi di perairan bersifat racun bagi ikan mas komet dan dapat mempersingkat waktu hidupnya.

quote: dimana pada perlakuan E (4%) ikan mengalami kematian pada ulangan 1,3, dan 4, sedangkan pada perlakuan D (3,5%) ikan hidup pada semua ulangan, oleh karena itu pada penelitian ini perlakuan D (3,5%) yang memberikan hasil terbaik.
statement: Perlakuan konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu 4% menyebabkan kematian ikan pada beberapa ulangan, sedangkan konsentrasi 3,5% membuat ikan hidup pada semua ulangan.
text_en: Perlakuan konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu 4% menyebabkan kematian ikan pada beberapa ulangan, sedangkan konsentrasi 3,5% membuat ikan hidup pada semua ulangan.

quote: Pengamatan terhadap kualitas air (D.O, pH, salinitas, suhu) dilakukan sebelum dan sesudah perlakuan, dari hasil yang diperoleh selama penelitian menunjukkan adanya beberapa perubahan, namun kisaran nilai kualitas air masih layak untuk kelangsungan hidup dan pertumbuhan ikan mas komet dan Argulus, hal ini menunjukkan kualitas air tidak mempengaruhi hasil penelitian.
statement: Perubahan kualitas air selama penelitian masih dalam kisaran yang layak bagi kelangsungan hidup dan pertumbuhan ikan serta parasit, sehingga kualitas air dianggap tidak mempengaruhi hasil penelitian.
text_en: Perubahan kualitas air selama penelitian masih dalam kisaran yang layak bagi kelangsungan hidup dan pertumbuhan ikan serta parasit, sehingga kualitas air dianggap tidak mempengaruhi hasil penelitian.

quote: Perasan buah mengkudu (Morinda citrifolia) dapat digunakan untuk mengendalikan Argulus dan konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu yang paling tepat untuk mengendalikan Argulus yang menyerang ikan mas komet (Carassius auratus auratus) ukuran juvenile, yaitu pada perlakuan D dengan konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu sebesar 3,5 % dengan lama perendaman 15 menit.
statement: Perasan buah mengkudu konsentrasi 3,5% dengan perendaman 15 menit efektif mengendalikan Argulus pada ikan mas komet juvenil.
text_en: Perasan buah mengkudu konsentrasi 3,5% dengan perendaman 15 menit efektif mengendalikan Argulus pada ikan mas komet juvenil.

quote: Fish in five groups were subjected to intraperitoneal injection with the five bacterial concentrations at a dose of 200 μL/fish, respectively.
statement: 五组鱼分别接受腹腔注射不同浓度的细菌悬液，剂量为每尾200微升。
text_zh: 五组鱼分别接受腹腔注射不同浓度的细菌悬液，剂量为每尾200微升。
text_en: Five groups of fish each received intraperitoneal injection of bacterial suspensions at different concentrations, with a dose of 200 microliters per fish.

quote: All fish were raised for 7 days at 25°C for the purpose of observing and recording pathologic symptoms.
statement: 所有鱼在25°C下饲养7天以观察和记录病理症状。
text_zh: 所有鱼在25°C下饲养7天以观察和记录病理症状。
text_en: All fish were kept at 25°C for 7 days to observe and record pathological symptoms.

quote: Intestine, spleen, liver, kidney and gill from the moribund fish after infection were fixed in Bouin’s fixative, dehydrated in ethanol, embedded in paraffin wax blocks, sectioned at 4 μm, and stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) for histopathological observation.
statement: 对濒死鱼的肠道、脾脏、肝脏、肾脏和鳃进行固定、脱水、包埋、切片和染色以进行组织病理学观察。
text_zh: 对濒死鱼的肠道、脾脏、肝脏、肾脏和鳃进行固定、脱水、包埋、切片和染色以进行组织病理学观察。
text_en: The intestines, spleen, liver, kidneys, and gills of moribund fish were fixed, dehydrated, embedded, sectioned, and stained for histopathological observation.

quote: Aeromonas spp. are important conditional pathogens, which often cause infection after host injury or stress response (Jeney and Jeney, 1995).
statement: 气单胞菌属是重要的条件致病菌，常在宿主受伤或应激反应后引起感染。
text_zh: 气单胞菌属是重要的条件致病菌，常在宿主受伤或应激反应后引起感染。
text_en: Aeromonas is an important opportunistic pathogen that often causes infection after host injury or stress response.

quote: They are also primary pathogens in farmed fish (Hossain et al., 2019).
statement: 它们也是养殖鱼类的主要病原体。
text_zh: 它们也是养殖鱼类的主要病原体。
text_en: They are also major pathogens of farmed fish.

quote: Among them, A. hydrophila had been considered to be the most harmful for aquatic animals, frequently causing haemorrhagic disease in farmed fish (Wang et al., 2017 ; Marinho-Neto et al., 2019).
statement: 其中，嗜水气单胞菌被认为对水生动物危害最大，常导致养殖鱼类的出血性疾病。
text_zh: 其中，嗜水气单胞菌被认为对水生动物危害最大，常导致养殖鱼类的出血性疾病。
text_en: Among them, Aeromonas hydrophila is considered the most harmful to aquatic animals and often causes hemorrhagic disease in farmed fish.

quote: The clinical symptoms of infected fish commonly comprised ulcer, fin rot/tail rot, abdominal distention, exophthalmia and hemorrhage.
statement: 受感染鱼的临床症状通常包括溃疡、鳍/尾腐烂、腹部膨胀、突眼和出血。
text_zh: 受感染鱼的临床症状通常包括溃疡、鳍/尾腐烂、腹部膨胀、突眼和出血。
text_en: Clinical signs in infected fish typically include ulcers, fin/tail rot, abdominal distension, exophthalmos and hemorrhage.

quote: However, symptoms are not presented homogeneously across infected fish; different pathogenicity is observed depending on the particular bacterial isolates or strains.
statement: 然而，症状在受感染的鱼中并非均匀呈现；根据特定的细菌分离株或菌株，观察到不同的致病性。
text_zh: 然而，症状在受感染的鱼中并非均匀呈现；根据特定的细菌分离株或菌株，观察到不同的致病性。
text_en: However, symptoms are not uniformly presented in infected fish; different pathogenicity was observed depending on the specific bacterial isolate or strain.

quote: Drug sensitivity tests were performed using drug impregnated disks (Hangzhou Binhe Microorganism Reagent Co., Ltd., China), which contained 34 drugs (Table 1).
statement: 使用含药纸片法对CFJY-623分离株进行了34种药物的敏感性测试。
text_zh: 使用含药纸片法对CFJY-623分离株进行了34种药物的敏感性测试。
text_en: The disk diffusion method was used to test the susceptibility of CFJY-623 isolates to 34 drugs.

quote: hal ini disebabkan Argulus tersebut tidak mampu bertahan terhadap perubahan lingkungan (air) akibat perasan buah mengkudu yang diberikan, selain itu diduga disebabkan Argulus tersebut tidak cocok terhadap inangnya.
statement: Argulus lepas karena tidak mampu bertahan terhadap perubahan lingkungan akibat pemberian perasan buah mengkudu atau karena ketidakcocokan dengan inang.
text_en: Argulus lepas karena tidak mampu bertahan terhadap perubahan lingkungan akibat pemberian perasan buah mengkudu atau karena ketidakcocokan dengan inang.

quote: Pada perlakuan C terdapat dua ekor Argulus lepas (ulangan kedua dan keempat), hal ini dikarenakan Argulus tersebut merasa tidak nyaman terhadap perubahan lingkungannya sehingga melepaskan diri dari ikan.
statement: Argulus melepaskan diri dari ikan pada perlakuan C karena merasa tidak nyaman terhadap perubahan lingkungan.
text_en: Argulus melepaskan diri dari ikan pada perlakuan C karena merasa tidak nyaman terhadap perubahan lingkungan.

quote: Pada perlakuan D ulangan 1-3 menunjukkan sebesar 66,66% Argulus lepas, hal tersebut disebabkan Argulus tidak mampu bertahan terhadap kandungan antiparasit yang terdapat pada perasan buah mengkudu pada konsentrasi 3,5%.
statement: Sebesar 66,66% Argulus lepas pada perlakuan D karena tidak mampu bertahan terhadap kandungan antiparasit dalam perasan buah mengkudu konsentrasi 3,5%.
text_en: Sebesar 66,66% Argulus lepas pada perlakuan D karena tidak mampu bertahan terhadap kandungan antiparasit dalam perasan buah mengkudu konsentrasi 3,5%.

quote: Pada perlakuan E ulangan kedua menunjukkan sebesar 100% Argulus lepas, sedangkan pada ulangan pertama, ketiga, dan keempat menunjukkan satu ekor Argulus lepas pada masing-masing ulangan.
statement: Pada perlakuan E, terjadi pelepasan Argulus dengan variasi tingkat keberhasilan antar ulangan.
text_en: Pada perlakuan E, terjadi pelepasan Argulus dengan variasi tingkat keberhasilan antar ulangan.

quote: Ikan pada semua perlakuan sebelum diinfestasi Argulus bergerak normal, tetapi 15 menit setelah ikan diinfestasi Argulus ikan menunjukkan tingkah laku yang tidak normal, hal ini disebabkan oleh adanya Argulus yang menempel pada tubuh ikan sehingga membuat ikan merasa tidak nyaman
statement: Infestasi Argulus menyebabkan ikan menunjukkan tingkah laku tidak normal karena merasa tidak nyaman akibat parasit yang menempel.
text_en: Infestasi Argulus menyebabkan ikan menunjukkan tingkah laku tidak normal karena merasa tidak nyaman akibat parasit yang menempel.

quote: Setelah diberikan perlakuan (15 menit) ikan dipindahkan kembali ke air tawar yang bersih untuk menghilangkan stres dan racun yang menempel pada tubuh ikan (Husnawati, 2006)
statement: Pemindahan ikan ke air tawar bersih setelah perlakuan bertujuan untuk menghilangkan stres dan racun yang menempel pada tubuh ikan.
text_en: Pemindahan ikan ke air tawar bersih setelah perlakuan bertujuan untuk menghilangkan stres dan racun yang menempel pada tubuh ikan.

quote: Aeromonas species often cause disease in farmed fish.
statement: 气单胞菌属常导致养殖鱼类患病。
text_zh: 气单胞菌属常导致养殖鱼类患病。
text_en: Aeromonas species commonly cause disease in farmed fish.

quote: Six virulence genes related to pathogenicity including aerolysin, cytotonic enterotoxins, elastase, glycerophospholipid: cholesterol acyltransferase, lipase, and serine protease were identified in this A. veronii isolate.
statement: 在该维氏气单胞菌分离株中鉴定出六个与致病性相关的毒力基因，包括气溶素、细胞毒性肠毒素、弹性蛋白酶、甘油磷脂：胆固醇酰基转移酶、脂肪酶和丝氨酸蛋白酶。
text_zh: 在该维氏气单胞菌分离株中鉴定出六个与致病性相关的毒力基因，包括气溶素、细胞毒性肠毒素、弹性蛋白酶、甘油磷脂：胆固醇酰基转移酶、脂肪酶和丝氨酸蛋白酶。
text_en: Six virulence genes associated with pathogenicity were identified in this Aeromonas veronii isolate, including aerolysin, cytotoxic enterotoxin, elastase, glycerophospholipid:cholesterol acyltransferase, lipase, and serine protease.

quote: The median lethal dosage (LD50) of the CFJY-623 isolate for crucian carp was determined as 1.31 × 10 7 CFU/mL.
statement: CFJY-623分离株对鲫鱼的半数致死量（LD50）测定为1.31 × 10^7 CFU/mL。
text_zh: CFJY-623分离株对鲫鱼的半数致死量（LD50）测定为1.31 × 10^7 CFU/mL。
text_en: The median lethal dose (LD50) of the CFJY-623 isolate for crucian carp was determined to be 1.31 × 10^7 CFU/mL.

quote: Artificial experimental infection showed that the CFJY-623 isolate caused considerable histological lesions in the fish, including tissue cell degeneration, necrosis, and inflammatory cell infiltrating.
statement: 人工实验感染显示，CFJY-623分离株在鱼体内引起显著的组织病变，包括组织细胞变性、坏死和炎症细胞浸润。
text_zh: 人工实验感染显示，CFJY-623分离株在鱼体内引起显著的组织病变，包括组织细胞变性、坏死和炎症细胞浸润。
text_en: Artificial experimental infection showed that the CFJY-623 isolate caused significant tissue lesions in fish, including cellular degeneration, necrosis, and inflammatory cell infiltration.

quote: The values in two groups infected with 1 × 10 9 and 1 × 10 8 CFU/mL bacterial suspension are both 100% while those in the other groups are all 10%.
statement: 在感染浓度为1×10^9和1×10^8 CFU/mL细菌悬浮液的两组中，死亡率均为100%，而在其他浓度组中死亡率均为10%。
text_zh: 在感染浓度为1×10^9和1×10^8 CFU/mL细菌悬浮液的两组中，死亡率均为100%，而在其他浓度组中死亡率均为10%。
text_en: In the two groups infected with bacterial suspensions at concentrations of 1×10^9 and 1×10^8 CFU/mL, mortality was 100%, while in the other concentration groups, mortality was 10%.

quote: The experimentally infected fish showed obvious pathological lesions. Multiple organs and tissues displayed extensive hemorrhaging, necrosis, and inflammatory cells infiltrating (Figure
statement: 实验感染的鱼显示出明显的病理病变，多个器官和组织表现出广泛的出血、坏死和炎症细胞浸润。
text_zh: 实验感染的鱼显示出明显的病理病变，多个器官和组织表现出广泛的出血、坏死和炎症细胞浸润。
text_en: Experimentally infected fish showed obvious pathological lesions, with extensive hemorrhage, necrosis, and inflammatory cell infiltration in multiple organs and tissues.

quote: Drug sensitivity testing on the CFJY-623 isolate in this study provide a reference for when antimicrobials may be a potential treatment for A. veronii infection.
statement: 对CFJY-623分离株进行的药物敏感性测试为何时将抗菌剂作为维氏气单胞菌感染的潜在治疗方法提供了参考。
text_zh: 对CFJY-623分离株进行的药物敏感性测试为何时将抗菌剂作为维氏气单胞菌感染的潜在治疗方法提供了参考。
text_en: Drug susceptibility testing performed on the CFJY-623 isolate provided a reference for when antimicrobial agents could be used as a potential treatment for Aeromonas veronii infection.

quote: beberapa ikan terlihat berenang tidak teratur dan menggesek- gesekkan tubuhnya ke dinding bak akibat Argulus yang masih menempel pada tubuh ikan
statement: Beberapa ikan menunjukkan perilaku berenang tidak teratur dan menggosokkan tubuh karena parasit Argulus yang masih menempel.
text_en: Beberapa ikan menunjukkan perilaku berenang tidak teratur dan menggosokkan tubuh karena parasit Argulus yang masih menempel.

quote: pada beberapa ekor ikan terlihat luka (ulsera) dan bintik-bintik merah (petechiae) yang diakibatkan oleh Argulus
statement: Ditemukan luka ulsera dan petechiae pada beberapa ikan yang disebabkan oleh Argulus.
text_en: Ditemukan luka ulsera dan petechiae pada beberapa ikan yang disebabkan oleh Argulus.

quote: hal ini sesuai dengan pendapat Thompson (1984) dalam Khoiron (2005) yang mengatakan petechiae diakibatkan oleh berbagai macam sebab, diantaranya adalah karena adanya toksin yang dikeluarkan oleh parasit pada saat terjadi infestasi.
statement: Petechiae dapat disebabkan oleh toksin yang dikeluarkan parasit selama infestasi.
text_en: Petechiae dapat disebabkan oleh toksin yang dikeluarkan parasit selama infestasi.

quote: Pada perlakuan E, beberapa ekor ikan mengalami kematian, sedangkan pada perlakuan B, C, dan D ikan tidak mengalami kematian, hal ini menunjukkan perendaman ikan dengan konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu 2,5-3,5% aman digunakan pada ikan dengan lama waktu perendaman 15 menit.
statement: Perendaman dengan konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu 2,5-3,5% selama 15 menit dianggap aman karena tidak menyebabkan kematian, berbeda dengan perlakuan E.
text_en: Perendaman dengan konsentrasi perasan buah mengkudu 2,5-3,5% selama 15 menit dianggap aman karena tidak menyebabkan kematian, berbeda dengan perlakuan E.

quote: semakin besar dosis perasan buah mengkudu yang diberikan maka akan semakin berpengaruh terhadap lepasnya Argulus... selain itu juga dapat memperbesar tingkat kematian pada ikan mas komet atau mempersingkat waktu hidup dari ikan itu sendiri
statement: Dosis perasan buah mengkudu yang lebih tinggi meningkatkan pelepasan Argulus tetapi juga meningkatkan tingkat kematian ikan mas komet.
text_en: Dosis perasan buah mengkudu yang lebih tinggi meningkatkan pelepasan Argulus tetapi juga meningkatkan tingkat kematian ikan mas komet.
outcome: kesehatan ikan vs efektivitas pengendalian parasit

quote: In the gills, mononuclear inflammatory infiltrating, hyperplasia, and necrosis of epithelia, as well as mild bleeding in gill lamellae were observed (Figure 4F).
statement: 在鳃部观察到单核细胞炎症浸润、上皮增生和坏死，以及鳃丝轻微出血。
text_zh: 在鳃部观察到单核细胞炎症浸润、上皮增生和坏死，以及鳃丝轻微出血。
text_en: Monocytic inflammatory infiltration, epithelial hyperplasia and necrosis, and slight hemorrhage of the gill filaments were observed in the gills.

quote: It was resistant to other tested antibiotics.
statement: 它对其他测试的抗生素具有耐药性。
text_zh: 它对其他测试的抗生素具有耐药性。
text_en: It is resistant to other tested antibiotics.

quote: The latent phase of growth was somewhat extended at pH 5, and extended markedly at pH 10.
statement: 在pH 5时，生长的潜伏期有所延长，而在pH 10时显著延长。
text_zh: 在pH 5时，生长的潜伏期有所延长，而在pH 10时显著延长。
text_en: At pH 5, the lag phase of growth was prolonged, and at pH 10 it was significantly prolonged.

quote: Histopathological observation of the intestine, gill, and viscera of infected fish showed that the A. veronii isolate caused obvious histological changes, which were similar to those associated with A. hydrophila (Sun et al., 1991 ; Marinho-Neto et al., 2019) and A. sobrinus (Sun et al., 1991).
statement: 对受感染鱼的肠道、鳃和内脏进行组织病理学观察显示，维氏气单胞菌分离株引起了明显的组织学变化，这些变化与嗜水气单胞菌和苏布利努斯气单胞菌相关的变化相似。
text_zh: 对受感染鱼的肠道、鳃和内脏进行组织病理学观察显示，维氏气单胞菌分离株引起了明显的组织学变化，这些变化与嗜水气单胞菌和苏布利努斯气单胞菌相关的变化相似。
text_en: Histopathological observation of the intestine, gills, and viscera of infected fish showed that Aeromonas veronii isolates caused distinct histological changes similar to those associated with Aeromonas hydrophila and Aeromonas sublividus.

quote: Fish diseases caused by different Aeromonas species are difficult to accurately diagnose according to the agent responsible for clinical symptoms and histological lesions
statement: 由不同气单胞菌属物种引起的鱼类疾病难以根据临床症状和组织病变的致病因子进行准确诊断。
text_zh: 由不同气单胞菌属物种引起的鱼类疾病难以根据临床症状和组织病变的致病因子进行准确诊断。
text_en: Fish diseases caused by different species of the genus Aeromonas are difficult to accurately diagnose based on clinical symptoms and tissue lesions.

quote: The results of the infection experiment also supported the viewpoint that A. veronii could probably be considered as an opportunistic pathogen in extensive circumstances
statement: 感染实验结果支持了A. veronii在粗放养殖条件下可能被视为条件致病菌的观点。
text_zh: 感染实验结果支持了A. veronii在粗放养殖条件下可能被视为条件致病菌的观点。
text_en: Infection experiment results support the view that A. veronii may be considered an opportunistic pathogen under extensive farming conditions.

quote: this pathogen became more pathogenic to fish under stress or in an unfavorable culture condition
statement: 该病原体在应激或不利养殖条件下对鱼类的致病性增强。
text_zh: 该病原体在应激或不利养殖条件下对鱼类的致病性增强。
text_en: The pathogenicity of this pathogen to fish is enhanced under stress or unfavorable farming conditions.

quote: According to the criteria put forward by Mittal et al. (1980) , a bacterial strain can be considered as moderately virulent if LD50 values are within the range of 10 6 to 10 7 CFU/g fish body weight.
statement: 根据Mittal等人提出的标准，如果LD50值在10^6至10^7 CFU/g鱼体重范围内，则细菌菌株可被视为中等毒力。
text_zh: 根据Mittal等人提出的标准，如果LD50值在10^6至10^7 CFU/g鱼体重范围内，则细菌菌株可被视为中等毒力。
text_en: According to the criteria proposed by Mittal et al., a bacterial strain can be considered of moderate virulence if its LD50 value is in the range of 10^6 to 10^7 CFU/g fish body weight.

quote: In our study, the LD50 of the CFJY-623 isolate was calculated as 1.31 × 10 7 CFU/mL which thus indicates that it is moderately virulent to C. auratus gibelio .
statement: 本研究中CFJY-623分离株的LD50计算为1.31 × 10^7 CFU/mL，表明其对银鲫具有中等毒力。
text_zh: 本研究中CFJY-623分离株的LD50计算为1.31 × 10^7 CFU/mL，表明其对银鲫具有中等毒力。
text_en: In this study, the LD50 of the CFJY-623 isolate was calculated as 1.31 × 10^7 CFU/mL, indicating moderate virulence to gibel carp.

quote: Multiple organs and tissues displayed extensive hemorrhaging, necrosis, and inflammatory cells infiltrating (Figure 4).
statement: 多个器官和组织显示出广泛的出血、坏死和炎症细胞浸润。
text_zh: 多个器官和组织显示出广泛的出血、坏死和炎症细胞浸润。
text_en: Multiple organs and tissues showed extensive hemorrhage, necrosis, and inflammatory cell infiltration.

quote: In the intestine, the connective tissue of submucosa was loose and inflammatory cells infiltrated the muscular layer and serosa (Figure 4A).
statement: 在肠道中，黏膜下层的结缔组织变得疏松，炎症细胞浸润了肌层和浆膜。
text_zh: 在肠道中，黏膜下层的结缔组织变得疏松，炎症细胞浸润了肌层和浆膜。
text_en: In the intestine, the connective tissue of the submucosa became loose, and inflammatory cells infiltrated the muscularis and serosa.

quote: The splenic tissue presented intensive alterations (Figure 4B), with abnormal structure and hemosiderin deposits.
statement: 脾脏组织呈现出强烈的改变，具有异常结构和含铁血黄素沉积。
text_zh: 脾脏组织呈现出强烈的改变，具有异常结构和含铁血黄素沉积。
text_en: The spleen tissue showed strong alterations, with abnormal structure and hemosiderin deposition.

quote: In the liver, severe cell swelling, karyolysis, cell necrosis, and intravascular congestion were observed (Figure 4D).
statement: 在肝脏中观察到严重的细胞肿胀、核溶解、细胞坏死和血管内充血。
text_zh: 在肝脏中观察到严重的细胞肿胀、核溶解、细胞坏死和血管内充血。
text_en: Severe cellular swelling, karyolysis, cell necrosis, and intravascular congestion were observed in the liver.

quote: The fish were acclimatized in a glass tank at a standardized temperature (26 ± 1 °C) and 14/10 h light/dark cycle conditions for two weeks before the experiments.
statement: 实验前，鱼在玻璃缸中于标准化温度（26 ± 1 °C）和14/10小时光照/黑暗周期条件下驯化两周。
text_zh: 实验前，鱼在玻璃缸中于标准化温度（26 ± 1 °C）和14/10小时光照/黑暗周期条件下驯化两周。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were acclimated for two weeks in glass tanks under standardized temperature (26 ± 1 °C) and a 14/10-hour light/dark cycle.
intervention: Environmental acclimation and water quality control

quote: The fish were fed on standard commercial diets, and the water in the glass tank was changed daily.
statement: 鱼喂食标准商业饲料，且玻璃缸中的水每天更换。
text_zh: 鱼喂食标准商业饲料，且玻璃缸中的水每天更换。
text_en: Fish were fed standard commercial feed, and the water in the glass tanks was changed daily.

quote: The fish were healthy and disease-free during domestication while ensuring normal activities. The natural mortality rate was less than 5%.
statement: 驯化期间鱼健康无病并保持正常活动，自然死亡率低于5%。
text_zh: 驯化期间鱼健康无病并保持正常活动，自然死亡率低于5%。
text_en: During the acclimation period, fish were healthy and disease-free and maintained normal activity, with a natural mortality rate of less than 5%.

quote: After a week of culture, 60 crucian carps were randomly selected and divided into four groups, 15 crucian carps were placed in each container.
statement: 经过一周养殖后，随机选取60条鲫鱼并分为四组，每个容器放置15条鱼。
text_zh: 经过一周养殖后，随机选取60条鲫鱼并分为四组，每个容器放置15条鱼。
text_en: After one week of farming, 60 crucian carp were randomly selected and divided into four groups, with 15 fish placed in each container.

quote: The use of fish for research purposes in this study followed ethical guidelines.
statement: 本研究中用于实验的鱼类的处理遵循了伦理指南。
text_zh: 本研究中用于实验的鱼类的处理遵循了伦理指南。
text_en: The handling of fish used in the experiments in this study followed ethical guidelines.

quote: The fish were acclimatized for at least 2 weeks in dechlorinated water at 17 to 18 °C, with pH of 7.2 ± 0.2, dissolved oxygen of 5.8 ± 0.2 mg/L, and a natural photoperiod of 11 h light and 13 h dark.
statement: 鱼在去氯水中驯化至少2周，水温17至18°C，pH值7.2±0.2，溶解氧5.8±0.2 mg/L，光照周期为11小时光照和13小时黑暗。
text_zh: 鱼在去氯水中驯化至少2周，水温17至18°C，pH值7.2±0.2，溶解氧5.8±0.2 mg/L，光照周期为11小时光照和13小时黑暗。
text_en: Fish were acclimated in dechlorinated water for at least 2 weeks, with a water temperature of 17 to 18°C, pH 7.2±0.2, dissolved oxygen 5.8±0.2 mg/L, and a light cycle of 11 hours light and 13 hours dark.

quote: Prior to the experiment, fish were starved for 24 h.
statement: 实验前，鱼被禁食24小时。
text_zh: 实验前，鱼被禁食24小时。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were fasted for 24 hours.

quote: For each group, 12 fish were raised in 30 L glass tanks (40 × 25 × 30 cm) containing 20 L of experimental solution under constant aeration.
statement: 每组12条鱼饲养在装有20升实验溶液的30升玻璃缸中，并持续曝气。
text_zh: 每组12条鱼饲养在装有20升实验溶液的30升玻璃缸中，并持续曝气。
text_en: Each group of 12 fish was kept in a 30-liter glass tank containing 20 liters of experimental solution, with continuous aeration.

quote: Three fish were sacrificed from each treatment at 1, 2, 4 and 7 days of exposure, and the brain and liver tissues were collected immediately for enzyme assays.
statement: 在暴露第1、2、4和7天从每个处理组处死三条鱼，并立即采集脑和肝组织用于酶测定。
text_zh: 在暴露第1、2、4和7天从每个处理组处死三条鱼，并立即采集脑和肝组织用于酶测定。
text_en: Three fish from each treatment group were sacrificed on days 1, 2, 4, and 7 of exposure, and brain and liver tissues were immediately collected for enzyme assays.

quote: continuous discharge could lead to false persistence and a threat to aquatic organisms
statement: 连续排放可能导致假持久性并对水生生物构成威胁。
text_zh: 连续排放可能导致假持久性并对水生生物构成威胁。
text_en: Continuous discharge may lead to pseudo-persistence and pose a threat to aquatic organisms.

quote: information is still lacking on the physiological effects upon crucian carp in vivo of exposure to ofloxacin, sulfamethoxazole and ibuprofen, especially at environmentally relevant concentrations
statement: 关于在环境相关浓度下暴露于氧氟沙星、磺胺甲恶唑和布洛芬对鲫鱼体内生理影响的信息仍然缺乏。
text_zh: 关于在环境相关浓度下暴露于氧氟沙星、磺胺甲恶唑和布洛芬对鲫鱼体内生理影响的信息仍然缺乏。
text_en: Information on the physiological effects in crucian carp exposed to ofloxacin, sulfamethoxazole, and ibuprofen at environmentally relevant concentrations is still lacking.

quote: acetylcholinesterase (AChE), 7-ethoxyresorufin-O-deethylase (EROD) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) activities in Carassius auratus are sensitive biomarkers for describing the toxic effects of pollutants on aquatic organisms
statement: 鲫鱼的乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）、7-乙氧基异佛尔酮-O-脱乙基酶（EROD）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性是描述污染物对水生生物毒性作用的敏感生物标志物。
text_zh: 鲫鱼的乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）、7-乙氧基异佛尔酮-O-脱乙基酶（EROD）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性是描述污染物对水生生物毒性作用的敏感生物标志物。
text_en: The activities of acetylcholinesterase (AChE), 7-ethoxyisophorone-O-deethylase (EROD), and superoxide dismutase (SOD) in crucian carp are sensitive biomarkers describing the toxic effects of pollutants on aquatic organisms.

quote: For ibuprofen, the age at first reproduction was delayed significantly in F3 and F4 and the offspring number decreased obviously in F3, F4, and F5 at 900.0 μg/L [ 16 ].
statement: 布洛芬在900.0 μg/L浓度下导致F3和F4代首次繁殖年龄显著延迟，且F3、F4和F5代后代数量明显减少。
text_zh: 布洛芬在900.0 μg/L浓度下导致F3和F4代首次繁殖年龄显著延迟，且F3、F4和F5代后代数量明显减少。
text_en: Ibuprofen at a concentration of 900.0 μg/L caused a significant delay in the age at first reproduction in the F3 and F4 generations, and significantly reduced the number of offspring in the F3, F4, and F5 generations.

quote: some drugs can exert physiological stress on aquatic organisms in the wild or under experimental exposure
statement: Some drugs can cause physiological stress to aquatic organisms in the wild or during experimental exposure.
text_en: Some drugs can cause physiological stress to aquatic organisms in the wild or during experimental exposure.

quote: Ofloxacin is a synthetic chemotherapeutic antibiotic of fluoroquinolone, which is the most commonly used to treat infections in medicine [ 8 , 9 ] and aquaculture [ 10 ].
statement: Ofloxacin is the most commonly used antibiotic to treat infections in aquaculture.
text_en: Ofloxacin is the most commonly used antibiotic to treat infections in aquaculture.

quote: AChE activity was significantly inhibited in response to treatment with >0.05mg/L ofloxacin and >0.02 mg/L sulfamethoxazole.
statement: 在>0.05 mg/L的氧氟沙星和>0.02 mg/L的磺胺甲恶唑处理下，AChE活性受到显著抑制。
text_zh: 在>0.05 mg/L的氧氟沙星和>0.02 mg/L的磺胺甲恶唑处理下，AChE活性受到显著抑制。
text_en: AChE activity was significantly inhibited under treatment with >0.05 mg/L ofloxacin and >0.02 mg/L sulfamethoxazole.
intervention_record: 高浓度氧氟沙星与磺胺甲恶唑

quote: the results indicated that exposure to ibuprofen and the mixture at environmentally relevant concentrations could trigger adverse impacts on Carassius auratus .
statement: 结果表明，在环境相关浓度下暴露于布洛芬及其混合物可能对鲫鱼产生不利影响。
text_zh: 结果表明，在环境相关浓度下暴露于布洛芬及其混合物可能对鲫鱼产生不利影响。
text_en: The results indicate that exposure to ibuprofen and its mixtures at environmentally relevant concentrations may have adverse effects on crucian carp.
intervention_record: 环境浓度布洛芬及混合物

quote: Moreover, the present study showed that the effects of ofloxacin, sulfamethoxazole and ibuprofen might be additive on the physiological indices of Carassius auratus .
statement: 此外，本研究表明氧氟沙星、磺胺甲恶唑和布洛芬对鲫鱼生理指标的影响可能是相加的。
text_zh: 此外，本研究表明氧氟沙星、磺胺甲恶唑和布洛芬对鲫鱼生理指标的影响可能是相加的。
text_en: In addition, this study indicates that the effects of ofloxacin, sulfamethoxazole, and ibuprofen on physiological indicators of crucian carp may be additive.

quote: Similar phenomena in tongue soles infected with a pathogenic Shewanella algae were reported by Han et al. (2017) , who noted that the short incubation period resulted in rapid disease progression.
statement: Han等人(2017)报道了感染致病性海藻希瓦氏菌的舌鳎出现类似现象，指出短潜伏期导致疾病快速进展。
text_zh: Han等人(2017)报道了感染致病性海藻希瓦氏菌的舌鳎出现类似现象，指出短潜伏期导致疾病快速进展。
text_en: Han et al. (2017) reported similar phenomena in tongue sole infected with pathogenic Shewanella algae, noting that a short incubation period led to rapid disease progression.

quote: The diseased fish infected with Aeromonas species tended to exhibit various clinical symptoms including cutaneous hemorrhage, gill congestion, hyphema, hemorrhages in fins and operculum, abdominal congestion, abdominal swelling, hepatic portal redness, and intestinal swelling.
statement: 感染气单胞菌属的病鱼倾向于表现出多种临床症状，包括皮肤出血、鳃充血、玻璃样变、鳍和鳃盖出血、腹部充血、腹部肿胀、肝门发红和肠道肿胀。
text_zh: 感染气单胞菌属的病鱼倾向于表现出多种临床症状，包括皮肤出血、鳃充血、玻璃样变、鳍和鳃盖出血、腹部充血、腹部肿胀、肝门发红和肠道肿胀。
text_en: Fish infected with Aeromonas species tend to exhibit multiple clinical signs, including skin hemorrhage, gill congestion, hyaline degeneration, fin and operculum hemorrhage, abdominal congestion, abdominal swelling, redness of the hepatic portal area, and intestinal swelling.

quote: In this study, gray gill and intestinal edema occurred in crucian carp infected with the CFJY-623 isolate.
statement: 在本研究中，感染CFJY-623分离株的鲫鱼出现了灰鳃和肠水肿。
text_zh: 在本研究中，感染CFJY-623分离株的鲫鱼出现了灰鳃和肠水肿。
text_en: In this study, crucian carp infected with the CFJY-623 isolate exhibited gray gills and intestinal edema.

quote: However, these symptoms were not manifested following infection with an A. veronii isolate in a study reported by Zhang et al. (2017) , but were manifested following infection with an A. militaris isolate reported by Li et al. (2017) .
statement: 然而，这些症状并未在Zhang等人(2017)报道的维氏气单胞菌分离株感染后出现，但在Li等人(2017)报道的米氏气单胞菌分离株感染后出现。
text_zh: 然而，这些症状并未在Zhang等人(2017)报道的维氏气单胞菌分离株感染后出现，但在Li等人(2017)报道的米氏气单胞菌分离株感染后出现。
text_en: However, these symptoms did not appear after infection with Aeromonas veronii isolates reported by Zhang et al. (2017), but appeared after infection with Aeromonas militaris isolates reported by Li et al. (2017).
intervention: A. veronii vs A. militaris infection
intervention_record: 维氏与军事气单胞菌感染对比
outcome: 不同菌株导致的症状差异

quote: No mortality occurred during the experiments.
statement: 实验期间没有发生死亡。
text_zh: 实验期间没有发生死亡。
text_en: No deaths occurred during the experimental period.

quote: As previously reported, in response to pollutants, AChE activity was inhibited in fish, which subsequently affected their growth, survival, feeding and reproductive behaviors [ 27 , 28 ].
statement: 据先前报道，鱼类对污染物的反应是乙酰胆碱酯酶活性受到抑制，进而影响其生长、存活、摄食和繁殖行为。
text_zh: 据先前报道，鱼类对污染物的反应是乙酰胆碱酯酶活性受到抑制，进而影响其生长、存活、摄食和繁殖行为。
text_en: According to previous reports, the response of fish to pollutants is the inhibition of acetylcholinesterase activity, which in turn affects their growth, survival, feeding and reproductive behavior.
outcome: 生长、存活、摄食和繁殖行为

quote: However, treatments with 0.25 and 1.258 mg/L ofloxacin as well as 0.5 mg/L sulfamethoxazole significantly inhibited AChE activity at day 4 or 7 (Figure 1 A,B).
statement: 较高浓度的氧氟沙星和磺胺甲恶唑处理在第4天或第7天显著抑制了乙酰胆碱酯酶活性。
text_zh: 较高浓度的氧氟沙星和磺胺甲恶唑处理在第4天或第7天显著抑制了乙酰胆碱酯酶活性。
text_en: Higher concentrations of ofloxacin and sulfamethoxazole treatment significantly inhibited acetylcholinesterase activity on day 4 or day 7.
intervention_record: 高浓度氧氟沙星与磺胺甲恶唑

quote: These results partially agree with Li et al. [ 29 ] who revealed that treatment with 50 mg/L sulfamethoxazole decreased AChE activity by 30% in goldfish and suggested that high levels of ofloxacin and sulfmethoxazole might negatively affect fish in environments.
statement: 先前研究指出高浓度磺胺甲恶唑会降低金鱼AChE活性，提示高水平药物可能对鱼类产生负面影响。
text_zh: 先前研究指出高浓度磺胺甲恶唑会降低金鱼AChE活性，提示高水平药物可能对鱼类产生负面影响。
text_en: Previous studies indicated that high concentrations of sulfamethoxazole reduce AChE activity in goldfish, suggesting that high levels of the drug may have negative effects on fish.

quote: Perhaps fish were able to compensate for injurious toxicological stresses by enhancing AChE activity [ 27 ].
statement: 鱼类可能通过增强乙酰胆碱酯酶活性来补偿有害的毒理学压力。
text_zh: 鱼类可能通过增强乙酰胆碱酯酶活性来补偿有害的毒理学压力。
text_en: Fish may compensate for harmful toxicological stress by enhancing acetylcholinesterase activity.

quote: The results showed that treatments with ofloxacin and sulfamethoxazole at environmentally relevant concentrations did not significantly change AChE, EROD and SOD activities.
statement: 在环境相关浓度下，氧氟沙星和磺胺甲恶唑处理未显著改变AChE、EROD和SOD活性。
text_zh: 在环境相关浓度下，氧氟沙星和磺胺甲恶唑处理未显著改变AChE、EROD和SOD活性。
text_en: At environmentally relevant concentrations, ofloxacin and sulfamethoxazole treatment did not significantly change AChE, EROD, and SOD activities.

quote: In comparison, treatments with low concentrations of sulfamethoxazole significantly decreased SOD activity.
statement: 低浓度磺胺甲恶唑处理显著降低了SOD活性。
text_zh: 低浓度磺胺甲恶唑处理显著降低了SOD活性。
text_en: Low concentration sulfamethoxazole treatment significantly reduced SOD activity.

quote: Exposure to high concentrations of ofloxacin and sulfamethoxazole showed slight toxicity to Carassius auratus .
statement: 高浓度氧氟沙星和磺胺甲恶唑暴露对鲫鱼表现出轻微毒性。
text_zh: 高浓度氧氟沙星和磺胺甲恶唑暴露对鲫鱼表现出轻微毒性。
text_en: Exposure to high concentrations of ofloxacin and sulfamethoxazole showed slight toxicity to crucian carp.
intervention_record: 高浓度氧氟沙星与磺胺甲恶唑

quote: However, the additive effects of the three tested pharmaceuticals on the EROD activity probably implied a potential high risk in the filled polluted area.
statement: 三种测试药物对EROD活性的叠加效应可能暗示在受污染区域存在潜在的高风险。
text_zh: 三种测试药物对EROD活性的叠加效应可能暗示在受污染区域存在潜在的高风险。
text_en: The additive effect of the three test drugs on EROD activity may suggest a potential high risk in contaminated areas.

quote: In the present study, treatments with environmentally relevant concentrations of ofloxacin (0.002 and 0.01 mg/L) and sulfamethoxazole (0.0008 and 0.004 mg/L) did not change EROD activity during the exposure period (Figure 2 A,B), whereas treatments with these two antibiotics significantly increased EROD activity at high concentrations.
statement: 在环境相关浓度下，氧氟沙星和磺胺甲恶唑处理未改变EROD活性，而在高浓度下显著增加了EROD活性。
text_zh: 在环境相关浓度下，氧氟沙星和磺胺甲恶唑处理未改变EROD活性，而在高浓度下显著增加了EROD活性。
text_en: At environmentally relevant concentrations, ofloxacin and sulfamethoxazole treatment did not change EROD activity, while at high concentrations it significantly increased EROD activity.

quote: These results suggest that additive effects exist among treatments with ofloxacin, sulfamethoxazole and ibuprofen.
statement: 结果表明氧氟沙星、磺胺甲恶唑和布洛芬的处理之间存在加性效应。
text_zh: 结果表明氧氟沙星、磺胺甲恶唑和布洛芬的处理之间存在加性效应。
text_en: The results indicate that there are additive effects among the treatments with ofloxacin, sulfamethoxazole, and ibuprofen.

quote: Histological damages detected in all intoxicated groups suggest that toxic metal enter the digestive tract of fish via the food, water or sediments that they consume, inducing an alteration of structures and functions in the fish’s intestine.
statement: 在中毒组中检测到的组织学损伤表明，有毒金属通过鱼摄入的食物、水或沉积物进入消化道，导致鱼肠道结构和功能的改变。
text_zh: 在中毒组中检测到的组织学损伤表明，有毒金属通过鱼摄入的食物、水或沉积物进入消化道，导致鱼肠道结构和功能的改变。
text_en: Histological damage detected in the poisoned group indicates that toxic metals entered the digestive tract through food, water, or sediment ingested by fish, leading to changes in the structure and function of the fish intestine.
outcome: 肠道结构与功能完整性

quote: Mucous-secreting goblet cells have proliferated and multiplied in all treated groups, indicating a defense mechanism against the severe pathological changes induced by CdCl2 contamination as Sayed et al., 2013 [44] have noticed on intestine of Nile Tilapia, Oreochromis niloticus, exposed to sublethal concentrations of cadmium.
statement: 所有处理组的黏液分泌杯状细胞均出现增殖和增多，这表明这是一种针对氯化镉污染引起的严重病理变化的防御机制。
text_zh: 所有处理组的黏液分泌杯状细胞均出现增殖和增多，这表明这是一种针对氯化镉污染引起的严重病理变化的防御机制。
text_en: Mucus-secreting goblet cells in all treatment groups showed proliferation and increase, indicating that this is a defense mechanism against severe pathological changes caused by cadmium chloride pollution.

quote: Our research findings show that Cd induces a significant increase in histopathological changes like vascular network hypertrophies and reach infiltrating leukocyte cells.
statement: 研究结果显示，镉（Cd）诱导了肠道组织病理学变化的显著增加，如血管网络肥大和大量浸润的白细胞。
text_zh: 研究结果显示，镉（Cd）诱导了肠道组织病理学变化的显著增加，如血管网络肥大和大量浸润的白细胞。
text_en: The study results showed that cadmium (Cd) induced a significant increase in intestinal histopathological changes, such as hypertrophy of the vascular network and massive infiltration of white blood cells.
outcome: 肠道健康/组织病理损伤

quote: In the same time, chlorella powder added to the fish diet, expressed the most effectiveness on the intestinal recovery of the cadmium-intoxicated fish followed by while cilantro and garlic powder.
statement: 同时，添加到鱼饲料中的小球藻粉对镉中毒鱼的肠道恢复表现出最高的有效性，其次是香菜和大蒜粉。
text_zh: 同时，添加到鱼饲料中的小球藻粉对镉中毒鱼的肠道恢复表现出最高的有效性，其次是香菜和大蒜粉。
text_en: At the same time, chlorella powder added to the fish diet showed the highest effectiveness for intestinal recovery in cadmium-poisoned fish, followed by coriander and garlic powder.

quote: The EROD activity in the gills and liver of the rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) increased by 28 to 58 times after exposure to 200 µg/L of propranolol [ 35 ].
statement: 虹鳟鱼（Oncorhynchus mykiss）的鳃和肝脏中的EROD活性在暴露于200 µg/L普萘洛尔后增加了28至58倍。
text_zh: 虹鳟鱼（Oncorhynchus mykiss）的鳃和肝脏中的EROD活性在暴露于200 µg/L普萘洛尔后增加了28至58倍。
text_en: EROD activity in the gills and liver of rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) increased by 28 to 58 times after exposure to 200 µg/L propranolol.

quote: However, excessive levels of pharmaceuticals lead to a decrease in enzyme activity.
statement: 然而，过量的药物水平会导致酶活性降低。
text_zh: 然而，过量的药物水平会导致酶活性降低。
text_en: However, excessive drug levels lead to reduced enzyme activity.

quote: The uncertain responses of SOD activity made it more complex to adopt SOD as a biomarker of antibiotic contaminations in fish.
statement: SOD活性的不确定反应使得将SOD作为鱼类抗生素污染的生物标志物变得更加复杂。
text_zh: SOD活性的不确定反应使得将SOD作为鱼类抗生素污染的生物标志物变得更加复杂。
text_en: The uncertain response of SOD activity makes using SOD as a biomarker for antibiotic contamination in fish more complex.

quote: A positive relationship was observed between SOD activity and the concentration of chemicals (Figure 3 C,D).
statement: 观察到SOD活性与化学物质浓度之间存在正相关关系。
text_zh: 观察到SOD活性与化学物质浓度之间存在正相关关系。
text_en: A positive correlation was observed between SOD activity and chemical substance concentration.

quote: Histopathological biomarkers have been primarily used in fish to identify and evaluate the toxic effects of exposure to contaminants
statement: 组织病理学生物标志物主要用于鱼类，以识别和评估污染物暴露的毒性效应。
text_zh: 组织病理学生物标志物主要用于鱼类，以识别和评估污染物暴露的毒性效应。
text_en: Histopathological biomarkers are mainly used in fish to identify and assess the toxic effects of pollutant exposure.

quote: we have propose to investigate chelating and antioxidant property of chlorella, coriander and garlic in Prussian carps’ cadmium-induced intoxication by comparative evaluation of the histopathological aspects of intestine tissue.
statement: 作者提议通过比较肠道组织的组织病理学方面，研究小球藻、香菜和大蒜在普鲁士鲤鱼镉中毒中的螯合和抗氧化特性。
text_zh: 作者提议通过比较肠道组织的组织病理学方面，研究小球藻、香菜和大蒜在普鲁士鲤鱼镉中毒中的螯合和抗氧化特性。
text_en: The authors proposed studying the chelating and antioxidant properties of Chlorella, coriander, and garlic in cadmium poisoning of Prussian carp by comparing histopathological aspects of intestinal tissue.
intervention: Garlic, coriander and Chlorella feed supplementation
intervention_record: 大蒜香菜小球藻饲料添加
outcome: 重金属中毒缓解/肠道健康

quote: In the Cd-intoxicated group, villi of intestinal mucosa are rarer and more heterogeneous than those of the control one.
statement: 在镉中毒组中，肠黏膜绒毛比对照组更稀疏且更不均匀。
text_zh: 在镉中毒组中，肠黏膜绒毛比对照组更稀疏且更不均匀。
text_en: In the cadmium poisoning group, the intestinal mucosal villi were sparser and more uneven than in the control group.

quote: Mucosal epithelium seems slightly disorganized and rarefied, crossed by infiltrating leukocyte cells
statement: 黏膜上皮似乎轻微紊乱和稀疏，并有浸润性白细胞穿过。
text_zh: 黏膜上皮似乎轻微紊乱和稀疏，并有浸润性白细胞穿过。
text_en: The mucosal epithelium appears slightly disordered and sparse, with infiltrating leukocytes passing through.
outcome: 炎症反应/上皮屏障功能

statement: 在镉和大蒜粉组（E2）中，肠道组织病理学检查显示肠绒毛呈矩形，吸收细胞间存在大量杯状细胞，基底膜富含胶原纤维，绒毛和固有层含有疏松结缔组织，血管网络轻微肥大，并有大量白细胞向黏膜表面迁移。
text_zh: 在镉和大蒜粉组（E2）中，肠道组织病理学检查显示肠绒毛呈矩形，吸收细胞间存在大量杯状细胞，基底膜富含胶原纤维，绒毛和固有层含有疏松结缔组织，血管网络轻微肥大，并有大量白细胞向黏膜表面迁移。
text_en: In the cadmium and garlic powder group (E2), intestinal histopathological examination showed rectangular intestinal villi, numerous goblet cells among absorptive cells, a basement membrane rich in collagen fibers, loose connective tissue in the villi and lamina propria, slight hypertrophy of the vascular network, and significant migration of leukocytes to the mucosal surface.
outcome: 肠道组织健康与免疫反应

of enterocytes, provided with striated plateau to
the apical pole, between which are numerous

and villi capillaries are obvious. Lax connective

statement: 在镉和香菜粉组（E3）中，肠道组织病理学检查显示肠绒毛呈矩形且发育均匀，上皮主要由具有纹状缘的肠细胞组成，其间有大量杯状细胞，基底膜和毛细血管明显，黏膜固有层的疏松结缔组织中含有大量浸润性白细胞。
text_zh: 在镉和香菜粉组（E3）中，肠道组织病理学检查显示肠绒毛呈矩形且发育均匀，上皮主要由具有纹状缘的肠细胞组成，其间有大量杯状细胞，基底膜和毛细血管明显，黏膜固有层的疏松结缔组织中含有大量浸润性白细胞。
text_en: In the cadmium and coriander powder group (E3), intestinal histopathological examination showed that the intestinal villi were rectangular and uniformly developed, the epithelium was mainly composed of enterocytes with a striated border, interspersed with numerous goblet cells, the basement membrane and capillaries were distinct, and the loose connective tissue of the lamina propria contained numerous infiltrating leukocytes.
outcome: 肠道组织健康与免疫反应

quote: presence of leukocyte infiltrative cells in migrating to the surface of the mucosa
statement: 在整个结缔组织中注意到有白细胞浸润细胞向黏膜表面迁移。
text_zh: 在整个结缔组织中注意到有白细胞浸润细胞向黏膜表面迁移。
text_en: Leukocyte infiltration with migration toward the mucosal surface was noted throughout the connective tissue.
outcome: 免疫细胞迁移/炎症反应

quote: Cilantro (Coriandrum sativum) by its principal constituent – linalool - can bind and immobilize cadmium chloride from liver and kidney [33] and decrease toxic tissues cadmium accumulation in cultured rainbow trout Oncorhynchus mykiss [34].
statement: 香菜的主要成分芳樟醇可以结合并固定肝脏和肾脏中的氯化镉，并减少养殖虹鳟鱼有毒组织中的镉积累。
text_zh: 香菜的主要成分芳樟醇可以结合并固定肝脏和肾脏中的氯化镉，并减少养殖虹鳟鱼有毒组织中的镉积累。
text_en: Linalool, the main component of cilantro, can bind and immobilize cadmium chloride in the liver and kidneys, and reduce cadmium accumulation in toxic tissues of farmed rainbow trout.

quote: Bioactive compounds from natural sources can act as oxygen free radical scavengers or metal chelators, which enables them to be used as natural antagonists to heavy metals toxicity.
statement: 天然来源的生物活性化合物可作为氧自由基清除剂或金属螯合剂，使其可用作重金属毒性的天然拮抗剂。
text_zh: 天然来源的生物活性化合物可作为氧自由基清除剂或金属螯合剂，使其可用作重金属毒性的天然拮抗剂。
text_en: Naturally derived bioactive compounds can act as oxygen free radical scavengers or metal chelators, making them usable as natural antagonists to heavy metal toxicity.

quote: So the present study was carried out to compare histologically the aspect of intestine tissue of Prussian carp specimens, subjected to chronic Cd intoxication with and without garlic, cilantro and chlorella dietary supplementation.
statement: 本研究旨在通过组织学比较慢性镉中毒的普鲁士鲤鱼肠道组织在有无大蒜、香菜和小球藻膳食补充下的情况。
text_zh: 本研究旨在通过组织学比较慢性镉中毒的普鲁士鲤鱼肠道组织在有无大蒜、香菜和小球藻膳食补充下的情况。
text_en: This study aims to compare the histology of intestinal tissue in Prussian carp with chronic cadmium poisoning, with and without dietary supplementation of garlic, cilantro, and Chlorella.
intervention: Garlic, coriander and Chlorella feed supplementation
intervention_record: 大蒜香菜小球藻饲料添加

quote: 150 Prussian carps, with weight of 10-12 g were divided according to the following treatments for 21 days: C (without treatment), E1 (10 ppm Cd into water), E2 (10 ppm Cd into water+2% lyophilized garlic in feed), E3 (10 ppm Cd into water+2% lyophilized cilantro in feed), E4 (10 ppm Cd into water+2% lyophilized chlorella in feed).
statement: 150条重10-12克的普鲁士鲤鱼被分为以下处理组进行21天实验：对照组（无处理）、E1组（水中添加10 ppm镉）、E2组（水中添加10 ppm镉+饲料中添加2%冻干大蒜）、E3组（水中添加10 ppm镉+饲料中添加2%冻干香菜）、E4组（水中添加10 ppm镉+饲料中添加2%冻干小球藻）。
text_zh: 150条重10-12克的普鲁士鲤鱼被分为以下处理组进行21天实验：对照组（无处理）、E1组（水中添加10 ppm镉）、E2组（水中添加10 ppm镉+饲料中添加2%冻干大蒜）、E3组（水中添加10 ppm镉+饲料中添加2%冻干香菜）、E4组（水中添加10 ppm镉+饲料中添加2%冻干小球藻）。
text_en: 150 Prussian carp weighing 10-12 g were divided into the following treatment groups for a 21-day experiment: control group (no treatment), E1 group (10 ppm cadmium added to water), E2 group (10 ppm cadmium added to water + 2% freeze-dried garlic added to feed), E3 group (10 ppm cadmium added to water + 2% freeze-dried coriander added to feed), E4 group (10 ppm cadmium added to water + 2% freeze-dried Chlorella added to feed).
intervention: Garlic, coriander and Chlorella feed supplementation
intervention_record: 大蒜香菜小球藻饲料添加

quote: Cadmium toxicity and the potential protective effect of the three lyophilized products against the impact of cadmium toxicity were histopathologically assessed.
statement: 通过组织病理学评估了镉毒性以及三种冻干产品对镉毒性影响的潜在保护作用。
text_zh: 通过组织病理学评估了镉毒性以及三种冻干产品对镉毒性影响的潜在保护作用。
text_en: The potential protective effects of three freeze-dried products against cadmium toxicity were assessed by histopathological evaluation.
intervention: Garlic, coriander and Chlorella feed supplementation
intervention_record: 大蒜香菜小球藻饲料添加

quote: Finally, the average number of normal and apoptotic cells (×15 magnification) in the gill filament from each group was counted in five different fields of view from five slices using ImageJ software, and apoptosis rate was quantified as the ratio of the number of apoptotic cells to the number of normal cells.
statement: 通过计数正常和凋亡细胞数量，将凋亡率量化为凋亡细胞数与正常细胞数的比率。
text_zh: 通过计数正常和凋亡细胞数量，将凋亡率量化为凋亡细胞数与正常细胞数的比率。
text_en: The apoptosis rate was quantified as the ratio of apoptotic cell count to normal cell count by counting the number of normal and apoptotic cells.

quote: For the purpose of detecting apoptosis- and immune-related gene expression, a total of five gills was pooled from each tank and subjected to qPCR assay.
statement: 为了检测细胞凋亡和免疫相关基因的表达，从每个水箱中收集五个鳃样本并进行qPCR分析。
text_zh: 为了检测细胞凋亡和免疫相关基因的表达，从每个水箱中收集五个鳃样本并进行qPCR分析。
text_en: To detect the expression of apoptosis- and immune-related genes, five gill samples were collected from each tank for qPCR analysis.
outcome: 细胞凋亡与免疫相关基因表达

quote: The therapeutic use of DEL immersion is intended to manage various diseases caused by parasites in the gills of farmed crucian fish.
statement: DEL浸浴疗法旨在管理养殖鲫鱼鳃部由寄生虫引起的各种疾病。
text_zh: DEL浸浴疗法旨在管理养殖鲫鱼鳃部由寄生虫引起的各种疾病。
text_en: DEL immersion therapy aims to manage various parasitic gill diseases in farmed crucian carp.

quote: However, there is limited knowledge on the impact of prolonged exposure to DEL on the commensal microbiome and gill injury of early-stage crucian carp.
statement: 关于长期接触DEL对早期阶段鲫鱼共生微生物群和鳃损伤的影响，目前知识有限。
text_zh: 关于长期接触DEL对早期阶段鲫鱼共生微生物群和鳃损伤的影响，目前知识有限。
text_en: Knowledge is currently limited regarding the effects of long-term exposure to DEL on the symbiotic microbiota and gill damage in early-stage crucian carp.

quote: Herein, in this study, we aimed to (a) investigate the detrimental impacts of chronic DEL exposure on the histological, mucosal barrier, inflammation, and apoptosis of the gill of crucian carp
statement: 本研究旨在调查慢性DEL暴露对鲫鱼鳃的组织学、黏膜屏障、炎症和细胞凋亡的有害影响。
text_zh: 本研究旨在调查慢性DEL暴露对鲫鱼鳃的组织学、黏膜屏障、炎症和细胞凋亡的有害影响。
text_en: This study aimed to investigate the harmful effects of chronic DEL exposure on histology, mucosal barrier, inflammation, and apoptosis in crucian carp gills.

quote: As a commonly used antiparasitic agent, deltamethrin (DEL) may have the potential adverse effects on external mucosa of fish such as gills.
statement: 溴氰菊酯（DEL）作为一种常用的抗寄生虫剂，可能对鱼类的外黏膜（如鳃）产生潜在的副作用。
text_zh: 溴氰菊酯（DEL）作为一种常用的抗寄生虫剂，可能对鱼类的外黏膜（如鳃）产生潜在的副作用。
text_en: Deltamethrin (DEL), as a commonly used antiparasitic agent, may have potential side effects on the external mucosa of fish (such as gills).

quote: The results of histological analysis revealed that severe hyperplasia in the secondary lamellae of gills was observed, and the number of goblet (mucus-secreting) cells increased significantly after DEL immersion.
statement: 组织学分析结果显示，在DEL浸浴后观察到鳃次级小梁严重增生，且杯状细胞数量显著增加。
text_zh: 组织学分析结果显示，在DEL浸浴后观察到鳃次级小梁严重增生，且杯状细胞数量显著增加。
text_en: Histological analysis results showed severe proliferation of secondary gill lamellae and a significant increase in the number of goblet cells after DEL immersion.
outcome: 鳃部组织结构与黏液分泌

quote: TUNEL staining indicated that the number of apoptotic cells increased in crucian carp gill.
statement: TUNEL染色表明鲫鱼鳃中凋亡细胞数量增加。
text_zh: TUNEL染色表明鲫鱼鳃中凋亡细胞数量增加。
text_en: TUNEL staining indicated an increase in the number of apoptotic cells in crucian carp gills.

quote: At the molecular level, the mRNA expression analysis revealed significant upregulation of apoptosis (caspase 3, caspase 8, and bax), autophagy (atg5 and beclin-1), and immune response (lzm, muc5, il-6, il-8, il-10, tnfα, ifnγ, tgfβ, tlr4, myd88, and nf-kb), whereas tight junction-related genes (occludin and claudin12) were downregulated after DEL immersion, suggesting that DEL immersion altered innate immunity responses and promoted mucus secretion.
statement: 在分子水平上，mRNA表达分析显示，DEL浸浴后凋亡、自噬和免疫反应相关基因显著上调，而紧密连接相关基因下调，这表明DEL浸浴改变了先天免疫反应并促进了黏液分泌。
text_zh: 在分子水平上，mRNA表达分析显示，DEL浸浴后凋亡、自噬和免疫反应相关基因显著上调，而紧密连接相关基因下调，这表明DEL浸浴改变了先天免疫反应并促进了黏液分泌。
text_en: At the molecular level, mRNA expression analysis showed that genes related to apoptosis, autophagy, and immune response were significantly upregulated after deltamethrin immersion, while genes related to tight junctions were downregulated, indicating that deltamethrin immersion altered the innate immune response and promoted mucus secretion.
outcome: 先天免疫反应与屏障功能

quote: Functional analyses revealed that the DEPs were enriched in apoptotic process, phagosome, and lysosome pathways.
statement: 功能分析显示差异表达蛋白富集于凋亡过程、吞噬体和溶酶体通路。
text_zh: 功能分析显示差异表达蛋白富集于凋亡过程、吞噬体和溶酶体通路。
text_en: Functional analysis showed that differentially expressed proteins were enriched in apoptosis processes, phagosome and lysosome pathways.

quote: Additionally, DEL immersion also drove gill microbiota to dysbiosis and an increase in potentially harmful bacteria such as Flavobacterium .
statement: 此外，溴氰菊酯浸浴还导致鳃部微生物群失调，并增加了黄杆菌属等潜在有害细菌的数量。
text_zh: 此外，溴氰菊酯浸浴还导致鳃部微生物群失调，并增加了黄杆菌属等潜在有害细菌的数量。
text_en: In addition, deltamethrin immersion also caused dysbiosis of the gill microbiota and increased the abundance of potentially harmful bacteria such as Flavobacterium.

quote: While DEL is generally regarded as safe, overuse can result in significant harm to the mucosal tissues of farmed animals and substantial economic losses [ 8 ].
statement: Although DEL is considered safe, its overuse causes significant harm to the mucosal tissues of farmed animals.
text_en: Although DEL is considered safe, its overuse causes significant harm to the mucosal tissues of farmed animals.

quote: After DEL misuse and overdose after administration, mortality and sublethal effects on aquatic organisms including oxidative impairment, neurotoxic responses, immunotoxic effects, and gut microbiota dysbiosis have been observed [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ].
statement: Misuse and overdose of DEL lead to mortality and sublethal effects such as oxidative impairment, neurotoxicity, immunotoxicity, and gut microbiota dysbiosis in aquatic organisms.
text_en: Misuse and overdose of DEL lead to mortality and sublethal effects such as oxidative impairment, neurotoxicity, immunotoxicity, and gut microbiota dysbiosis in aquatic organisms.
outcome: mortality, oxidative stress, neurotoxicity, immunotoxicity, gut microbiota

quote: Notwithstanding the evidence previously obtained, which suggests that chronic exposure to low doses of DEL has a disruptive effect on both intestinal health and the intestinal microbiota [ 12 ], insufficient data exist regarding the negative impacts of prolonged exposure to DEL at therapeutic levels on the external mucosal tissue of aquatic organisms.
statement: Chronic exposure to low doses of DEL disrupts intestinal health and microbiota, but there is insufficient data on the impact of prolonged therapeutic-level exposure on external mucosal tissue.
text_en: Chronic exposure to low doses of DEL disrupts intestinal health and microbiota, but there is insufficient data on the impact of prolonged therapeutic-level exposure on external mucosal tissue.
limitations: insufficient data regarding the negative impacts of prolonged exposure to DEL at therapeutic levels on the external mucosal tissue

quote: During this period, all fish were fed with commercial feed twice a day at 8:00 and 17:00, and any remaining feed and feces were extracted via siphoning.
statement: 在驯化期间，所有鱼每天两次（8:00和17:00）投喂商业饲料，并通过虹吸法清除剩余饲料和粪便。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，所有鱼每天两次（8:00和17:00）投喂商业饲料，并通过虹吸法清除剩余饲料和粪便。
text_en: During the acclimation period, all fish were fed commercial feed twice daily (8:00 and 17:00), and residual feed and feces were removed by siphoning.

quote: About one-third of the water was exchanged once a day and the water quality (dissolved oxygen 7.0 ± 1.0 mg/L, temperature 25 ± 1 °C, total ammonia nitrogen 0.03 ± 0.01 mg/L) was monitored daily.
statement: 每天交换约三分之一的水量，并每日监测溶解氧、温度和总氨氮等水质指标。
text_zh: 每天交换约三分之一的水量，并每日监测溶解氧、温度和总氨氮等水质指标。
text_en: Exchange about one-third of the water daily, and monitor water quality indicators such as dissolved oxygen, temperature, and total ammonia nitrogen every day.

quote: Each tank was aerated continuously with an aeration stone and the water temperature was kept at 25 ± 2 °C, and the pH value was maintained at 7 with the dissolved oxygen of 7.0 mg/L.
statement: 每个水箱使用曝气石连续充氧，水温保持在25±2°C，pH值维持在7，溶解氧为7.0 mg/L。
text_zh: 每个水箱使用曝气石连续充氧，水温保持在25±2°C，pH值维持在7，溶解氧为7.0 mg/L。
text_en: Each tank was continuously aerated using an aeration stone, with water temperature maintained at 25±2°C, pH kept at 7, and dissolved oxygen at 7.0 mg/L.

quote: stress is an important feature of SOD and can be used as an indicator of environmental stresses
statement: SOD是应激的重要特征，可用作环境应激的指标。
text_zh: SOD是应激的重要特征，可用作环境应激的指标。
text_en: SOD is an important characteristic of stress and can be used as an indicator of environmental stress.

quote: hepatic SOD activities significantly increased after exposure to 200 μg/L carbamazepine for 21 and 42 days
statement: 暴露于200 μg/L卡马西平21和42天后，肝脏SOD活性显著增加。
text_zh: 暴露于200 μg/L卡马西平21和42天后，肝脏SOD活性显著增加。
text_en: After 21 and 42 days of exposure to 200 μg/L carbamazepine, liver SOD activity significantly increased.

quote: treatment with ≥0.05 mg/L ofloxacin significantly increased SOD activity, but no effects were observed in treatments at environmentally relevant concentrations
statement: ≥0.05 mg/L氧氟沙星处理显著增加了SOD活性，但在环境相关浓度下未观察到影响。
text_zh: ≥0.05 mg/L氧氟沙星处理显著增加了SOD活性，但在环境相关浓度下未观察到影响。
text_en: Treatment with ≥0.05 mg/L ofloxacin significantly increased SOD activity, but no effect was observed at environmentally relevant concentrations.
counterevidence: 在环境相关浓度下无影响

quote: Treatments with high concentrations of sulfamethoxazole (≥0.1 mg/L) also significantly increased SOD activity.
statement: 高浓度磺胺甲恶唑（≥0.1 mg/L）处理也显著增加了SOD活性。
text_zh: 高浓度磺胺甲恶唑（≥0.1 mg/L）处理也显著增加了SOD活性。
text_en: Treatment with high concentrations of sulfamethoxazole (≥0.1 mg/L) also significantly increased SOD activity.

quote: Nevertheless, SOD activity was significantly suppressed in treatments with the two lowest concentrations of sulfamethoxazole at days 4 and 7
statement: 然而，在第4天和第7天，两个最低浓度的磺胺甲恶唑处理中SOD活性受到显著抑制。
text_zh: 然而，在第4天和第7天，两个最低浓度的磺胺甲恶唑处理中SOD活性受到显著抑制。
text_en: However, SOD activity was significantly inhibited in the two lowest concentration treatments of sulfamethoxazole on day 4 and day 7.

quote: This phenomenon might be due to the reduced bacterial charge in fish.
statement: 这种现象可能是由于鱼体内细菌负荷减少所致。
text_zh: 这种现象可能是由于鱼体内细菌负荷减少所致。
text_en: This phenomenon may be due to a reduction in bacterial load in the fish.

quote: Exposure to a low level of sulfamethoxazole should inhibit the growth of bacteria and consequently decrease the baseline level of antioxidant enzymes.
statement: 暴露于低水平磺胺甲恶唑应抑制细菌生长，从而降低抗氧化酶的基线水平。
text_zh: 暴露于低水平磺胺甲恶唑应抑制细菌生长，从而降低抗氧化酶的基线水平。
text_en: Exposure to low levels of sulfamethoxazole should inhibit bacterial growth, thereby reducing the baseline levels of antioxidant enzymes.

quote: There is a wealth of research indicating that exposure to pesticides can trigger oxidative stress, inflammation, autophagy, and apoptosis in the gills of fish
statement: 已有大量研究表明，接触农药可引发鱼类鳃部的氧化应激、炎症、自噬和凋亡。
text_zh: 已有大量研究表明，接触农药可引发鱼类鳃部的氧化应激、炎症、自噬和凋亡。
text_en: A large body of research has shown that exposure to pesticides can induce oxidative stress, inflammation, autophagy, and apoptosis in fish gills.
outcome: 鳃部组织损伤与生理应激

quote: Feng et al. found that the administration of abamectin to carp resulted in the induction of oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis, while also inhibiting autophagy through the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway
statement: Feng等人发现，给鲤鱼施用阿维菌素会导致氧化应激、炎症和凋亡的诱导，并通过PI3K/AKT/mTOR信号通路抑制自噬。
text_zh: Feng等人发现，给鲤鱼施用阿维菌素会导致氧化应激、炎症和凋亡的诱导，并通过PI3K/AKT/mTOR信号通路抑制自噬。
text_en: Feng et al. found that administration of abamectin to carp induced oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis, and inhibited autophagy via the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway.
outcome: 鳃部病理变化（氧化应激、炎症、凋亡、自噬）

quote: Sun et al. demonstrated that 4-octylphenol caused inflammatory injury and immunosuppression via tlr7/IκBα/NF-κB pathway in gill of common carp
statement: Sun等人证明，4-辛基苯酚通过tlr7/IκBα/NF-κB途径导致普通鲤鱼鳃部的炎症性损伤和免疫抑制。
text_zh: Sun等人证明，4-辛基苯酚通过tlr7/IκBα/NF-κB途径导致普通鲤鱼鳃部的炎症性损伤和免疫抑制。
text_en: Sun et al. demonstrated that 4-tert-octylphenol causes inflammatory damage and immunosuppression in the gills of common carp through the TLR7/IκBα/NF-κB pathway.
outcome: 鳃部炎症损伤与免疫抑制

quote: In turn, the inflammation of fish gill epithelia results in heightened permeability to pesticides, thereby exacerbating gill impairment
statement: 反过来，鱼鳃上皮的炎症导致对农药的通透性增加，从而加剧鳃部损伤。
text_zh: 反过来，鱼鳃上皮的炎症导致对农药的通透性增加，从而加剧鳃部损伤。
text_en: Conversely, inflammation of the fish gill epithelium leads to increased permeability to pesticides, thereby exacerbating gill damage.
outcome: 鳃部屏障功能受损与损伤加剧

quote: In the DEL-L group, immersion with DEL resulted in a significant reduction of occludin and claudin12 mRNA expression in the gill of crucian carp
statement: 在DEL-L组中，DEL浸泡导致鲫鱼鳃部occludin和claudin12的mRNA表达显著降低。
text_zh: 在DEL-L组中，DEL浸泡导致鲫鱼鳃部occludin和claudin12的mRNA表达显著降低。
text_en: In the DEL-L group, DEL immersion significantly reduced the mRNA expression of occludin and claudin12 in the gills of crucian carp.

quote: no statistically significant differences were observed when compared to the control group (p > 0.05)
statement: 与对照组相比，zo-1和muc2未观察到统计学上的显著差异。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，zo-1和muc2未观察到统计学上的显著差异。
text_en: Compared with the control group, no statistically significant differences were observed in zo-1 and muc2.

quote: In the DEL-L group, immersion with DEL remarkably upregulated the mRNA level of lzm (approximately 2.29-fold), nf-kb (approximately 2.43-fold), and ikba (approximately 1.77-fold) in crucian carp gill
statement: 在低剂量DEL浸浴组中，鲤鱼鳃部的lzm、nf-kb和ikba的mRNA水平显著上调。
text_zh: 在低剂量DEL浸浴组中，鲤鱼鳃部的lzm、nf-kb和ikba的mRNA水平显著上调。
text_en: In the low-dose DEL immersion group, mRNA levels of lzm, nf-kb and ikba in carp gills were significantly upregulated.

quote: Our results showed that there were no statistically significant variations observed in the estimates of richness (ACE and Chao1) and diversity (shannon and simpson index) indices between the DEL and Con groups (Figure 8 A).
statement: 研究结果显示，DEL组与对照组之间在鳃微生物群落的丰富度（ACE和Chao1）及多样性（Shannon和Simpson指数）估计值上无统计学显著差异。
text_zh: 研究结果显示，DEL组与对照组之间在鳃微生物群落的丰富度（ACE和Chao1）及多样性（Shannon和Simpson指数）估计值上无统计学显著差异。
text_en: The results showed no statistically significant difference in the estimated richness (ACE and Chao1) and diversity (Shannon and Simpson indices) of gill microbial communities between the DEL group and the control group.
outcome: 鳃部微生物群落多样性

quote: Overall, this study showed that DEL elicited shifts in the immune response and changes in the surface microbiota of fish.
statement: 总体而言，本研究表明溴氰菊酯引发了鱼类免疫反应的转变和体表微生物群的变化。
text_zh: 总体而言，本研究表明溴氰菊酯引发了鱼类免疫反应的转变和体表微生物群的变化。
text_en: Overall, this study indicates that deltamethrin triggered a shift in the fish immune response and changes in the surface microbiota.
outcome: 免疫反应与体表微生物群

quote: These results provide new perspectives on the conventional anthelmintic concentration of DEL immersion disorder of the gill immune microenvironment in crucian carp and theoretical support for future optimization of their practical application.
statement: 这些结果为常规浓度的溴氰菊酯浸浴引起鲫鱼鳃部免疫微环境紊乱提供了新的视角，并为其实际应用的未来优化提供了理论支持。
text_zh: 这些结果为常规浓度的溴氰菊酯浸浴引起鲫鱼鳃部免疫微环境紊乱提供了新的视角，并为其实际应用的未来优化提供了理论支持。
text_en: These results provide new insights into the disturbance of the immune microenvironment in the gills of crucian carp caused by deltamethrin immersion at conventional concentrations, and offer theoretical support for future optimization of its practical application.
outcome: 鳃部免疫微环境稳定性

quote: Deltamethrin (DEL) belongs to the category of type II pyrethroid insecticides and is capable of efficiently managing or averting parasitic diseases in aquaculture by disrupting the regular nervous system functioning of ectoparasites
statement: 溴氰菊酯属于II型拟除虫菊酯类杀虫剂，能够通过破坏体外寄生虫的正常神经系统功能来有效管理或预防水产养殖中的寄生虫病。
text_zh: 溴氰菊酯属于II型拟除虫菊酯类杀虫剂，能够通过破坏体外寄生虫的正常神经系统功能来有效管理或预防水产养殖中的寄生虫病。
text_en: Deltamethrin is a Type II pyrethroid insecticide that can effectively manage or prevent parasitic diseases in aquaculture by disrupting the normal nervous system function of ectoparasites.

quote: Presently, DEL has gained widespread acceptance as the preferred method for eliminating monogeneans, parasitic organisms that predominantly inhabit the external surface of fish.
statement: 目前，溴氰菊酯已被广泛接受为消除单殖吸虫（主要栖息在鱼体表的寄生虫）的首选方法。
text_zh: 目前，溴氰菊酯已被广泛接受为消除单殖吸虫（主要栖息在鱼体表的寄生虫）的首选方法。
text_en: Currently, deltamethrin is widely accepted as the preferred method for eliminating monogeneans (parasites that mainly inhabit the body surface of fish).

quote: Meanwhile, mucous cells were unevenly distributed on the primary gill filaments and the number of goblet (mucus-secreting) cells increased significantly in the fish gills with the increase in concentration of DEL
statement: 黏液细胞在原发鳃丝上分布不均，且随着DEL浓度增加，鱼鳃中的杯状（分泌黏液）细胞数量显著增加。
text_zh: 黏液细胞在原发鳃丝上分布不均，且随着DEL浓度增加，鱼鳃中的杯状（分泌黏液）细胞数量显著增加。
text_en: Mucus cells are unevenly distributed on the primary gill filaments, and the number of goblet (mucus-secreting) cells in the fish gills increased significantly with increasing DEL concentration.

quote: immersion with DEL significantly increased the ratio of apoptotic cells in the gill of crucian carp, as compared to the control group
statement: 与对照组相比，DEL浸浴显著增加了鲫鱼鳃部的细胞凋亡率。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，DEL浸浴显著增加了鲫鱼鳃部的细胞凋亡率。
text_en: Compared with the control group, DEL immersion significantly increased the apoptosis rate in the gills of crucian carp.

quote: the rates of apoptosis positivity exhibited a significant dose-dependent effect
statement: 细胞凋亡阳性率表现出显著的剂量依赖性效应。
text_zh: 细胞凋亡阳性率表现出显著的剂量依赖性效应。
text_en: The apoptosis positive rate showed a significant dose-dependent effect.

quote: After statistical analysis, a total of 428 DAPs were identified in the gills between the DEL-H and the control groups, including 341 upregulated DEGs and 87 downregulated DEGs
statement: 统计分析显示，高剂量DEL组与对照组之间在鳃部鉴定出428个差异蛋白，其中341个上调，87个下调。
text_zh: 统计分析显示，高剂量DEL组与对照组之间在鳃部鉴定出428个差异蛋白，其中341个上调，87个下调。
text_en: Statistical analysis showed that 428 differential proteins were identified in the gills between the high-dose DEL group and the control group, of which 341 were upregulated and 87 were downregulated.
